title: Pause and park
summary: Mode parked or turn posture waiting declares intentional pause. A paused work-claim holder remains parked as activity ages; silence alone never declares pause. Prompts, failed calls, park bookkeeping (messages acknowledge, items progress-log append, sessions touch, sessions wake schedule) and read-only calls preserve parked mode and its reason. Read-only calls are the Read, Grep and Glob tools, read-only Git inspection, and yoke commands whose registered function is a read (READ_COMMAND_ROUTES). Any other successful tool call, including a redirect or substitution, ends the park. Arm a Claude Monitor before parking as the final action of the turn. Successful work or an explicit mode wait ends it; delayed activity cannot clear a newer park. Capacity recovery skips parked sessions. A holder schedules its next recheck with sessions.wake.schedule for whenever time- or traffic-dependent evidence could plausibly exist, and again after every recheck that finds none. A claim holder sent a manual-wake QA notice for a requirement still open on a run executing its stage cannot park without a future unconsumed scheduled wake: the park refuses park_recheck_required naming the schedule command; parks before the stage opens are unaffected. Acknowledging a manual-wait notice, a release-takeover notice or a fired scheduled wake for that obligation refuses the same way until the next recheck is scheduled. Before parking on another item, record the merge or delivery wait through items.dependency.add; a dependency_cycle refusal must be resolved before parking. The held item’s own release wait needs no self-edge. A merge whose item owes nothing after deploy releases its work claim and does not park; the release closes the item without a holder. The Sessions page Active filter excludes sessions with native_process_gone_at set. Parked sessions remain visible under Parked with their held claims; process-gone parked workers use no machine lane until resumed. Claude Monitor resumes the current turn; ending that turn closes its reader. The harness capability evidence names this limit without changing idle_wake.
